english: Place the Unit-01 (Prototype) combat robot. FPV optics
schinese: palm beam cannon and guided missiles. Model CC-BY-4.0 ILUSHANDRO.
column8: 放置初号机（试验体）。第一视角、掌心光束炮与背部制导导弹。模型 CC-BY-4.0 ILUSHANDRO。

schinese: 初号机（试验体）专用的强化双足骨架，带关节安装座。

english: High-density energy cell for the palm beam.
schinese: 掌心光束炮用高密度能量电池。

english: Guided missile for the back pod. Hold G on a hostile target for 2 seconds to fire.
schinese: 背部发射巢用制导导弹。按住 G 锁定敌对目标 2 秒后自动发射。

english: Sword and shield Complete Form. Tap/hold left mouse for sword/heavy strike; right mouse guards; F charges forehead laser; G launches missiles; V scopes. Q toggles winged flight/landing; Space ascends; C descends; Shift accelerates. Sword/shield require landing. Uses shared ammunition.
schinese: 剑盾近战型完全体。左键点按剑击／按住蓄力重劈；右键举盾；F蓄能头炮；G导弹；V瞄准镜。Q展翼飞行/降落，空格上升、C下降、Shift加速；空中使用头炮与导弹，落地后使用剑盾。耐久300万、储油450L，共用机甲弹药。

english: Reinforced frame for Unit-01 Complete Form.
schinese: 初号机（完全体）专用强化骨架。
